snippet.title: USA Fight Back to Earn Draw With World Champions Spain | USWNT 2-2 Spain | Official Highlights
snippet.description: After going down 2-0 to Spain in the first half through goals from Alexia Putellas and Salma Paralluelo, the USWNT scored twice in the second half to earn a 2-2 draw. The NWSL leading scorer, Ashley Sanchez, scored in her first USWNT start in 714 days. Then second-half substitute Mallory Swanson scored the equalizer, which was her first goal for the U.S. since the Olympic gold medal match.
